The '''National Mathematics Society of Pakistan''' (NMSP), is an academic, non-profit, and scientific society of applied mathematicians and engineers dedicated to the development and promotion of applied mathematics at all levels.<ref name="Homepage of the National Mathematical Society of Pakistan">{{cite web|title=National Mathematical Society of Pakistan|url=http://www.nmsp.com.pk/|publisher=Directorate of the National Mathematical Society of Pakistan|accessdate=17 January 2012}}</ref>  The society is aim to serve as the national community by organizing seminars, workshops, competitions, meetings and publications.<ref name="Homepage of the National Mathematical Society of Pakistan"/>

Established in 2010, the society was initially headquartered in [[Abdus Salam School of Mathematical Sciences]] (AS-SMS), at the [[Government College University, Lahore]].<ref name="Homepage of the National Mathematical Society of Pakistan"/> It is working abroad to come and be a part of the international mathematical society and exchange ideas and skills with the other members of the society in Pakistan.<ref name="Homepage of the National Mathematical Society of Pakistan"/> It is currently the adhering organization of the [[International Mathematical Union]] on Pakistan.<ref name="Member Country: Pakistan"/>

On 2015, the [[Abdus Salam]] Shield Of Honor in Mathematics was initiated by NMSP to promote and recognize quality research in Mathematics. The first Shield was given to Prof. Hassan Azad from [[KFUPM]] in February 2016.<ref name="Professor Hassan Azad is the first recipient of ASSH">{{cite web|title=First recipient of ASSH|date=10 March 2016|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1244676|publisher=Dawn Magazine|access-date=25 August 2016}}</ref>

On 2017, NSMP initiated the Abdus Salam Medal for Mathematics to recognise the young and senior mathematicians at national and international levels for their excellent performance. The first recipients were Dr. Ayesha Asloob Qureshi from [[Sabancı University]] and Dr. Sahibzada Waleed Noor from [[University of Campinas]].<ref name="First recipients of Abdus Salam Medal">{{cite web|title=First recipients of Abdus Salam Medal|date=18 February 2018|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1390117|publisher=Dawn Magazine|accessdate=27 January 2021}}</ref>
